scope: Original author's report for 0.15.0-prototype29; not re-run as this suite for 0.16.0
tests: Vue compiles the complete editor and field templates
Prototype 24 migration preserves every existing value
Legacy browser settings migrate without overwriting their saved copy
Unsafe imports and invalid new settings are rejected
Edits do not apply until Apply for me
Undo and redo restore the previous setting
Invalid edits retain validation errors and are undoable
Preview and comparison leave applied settings unchanged
Apply saves browser settings and clears the draft
Autosave and closing preserve un-applied changes
My themes supports copy, load, delete and undo deletion
Search includes hidden dependent settings
Disabled linked colors show the actual palette and retain custom colors
Quota failure does not report an applied or saved theme
Isolated sample rendering makes no Farm Manager API request
Streams retain two anchors and obey economy mode
Reduced motion removes streams and glints
Glint selection, movement and hidden-tab pause
Personal exports include every module dependency
Prototype 25 settings and matching drafts migrate without overwriting v4
Independent palette effects resolve, reset and rejoin without changing the other palette
Runtime changes effective profiles with the FM palette attribute
Depth, air, glow, base shadow and hover compose in one declaration
Collection renaming, updating and source indicators track actual edits
Five applied snapshots persist while draft edits create no snapshots
Collection and history share assets and exports restore complete validated themes
Sample options stay outside the theme and clicks select settings safely
All six backgrounds validate and mixed bases exclude recursive or invalid options
Approved procedural shapes move, stay finite and respond to size and softness
Personal colors, light palette, mixed brightness and per-palette effects reach the renderer
Runtime creates one moving canvas, preserves its identity and combines it with streams
Hidden tabs, reduced motion, economy mode, disabled mode and zero brightness stop drawing correctly
Preview multiplier changes pixels without modifying theme settings and disposal cancels callbacks
Canvas creation failure is reported and classic flow remains available
Prototype 26 applied theme, draft and collection migrate while their old records remain intact
Adaptive quality keeps a painted frame while reducing the pixel budget
Simple and advanced modes share the exact theme and persist only the editor preference
Simple edits preserve hidden advanced parameters and palette profiles
Manual text sizes and custom pairs remain exact when switching modes
Combined glint control changes only the two target flags and displays mixed state
Simple mode renders a normal sample without erasing advanced preview preferences
iPhone and all built-in themes validate, cover the schema and avoid unbundled assets
Choosing iPhone is preview-only, can be undone, saved and applied
My themes remains available in simple mode and error navigation opens the full editor
Schema 11 migration preserves separated palettes and seeds new fields from their common values
Prototype 28 applied theme and matching draft migrate without overwriting v6 or the v3 collection
Every new number, boolean, color and material is validated before reaching CSS or SVG
All palette additions resolve and join precisely, including simple color changes
Advanced linked colors and material controls follow the selected palette and errors navigate to it
Text roles and independent radii produce safe scoped CSS with explicit precedence
Optical normals are neutral inside and opposite at opposite edges, with bounded visible geometry
Glass builds real displacement filters only on owned nodes, clips without a backdrop root, and disposes
Runtime glass pauses on hidden tabs and is removed on material switch, opaque fill and module disposal
All six editor sections render with Vue without runtime errors
Preview document updates every state, text checks, background-only mode and playback speed
limitations: Node/Vue logic, DOM simulation and displacement-map mathematics. No real browser layout, SVG backdrop compositing, FM installation or Windows performance test. CSS.supports checks parsing, not actual SVG backdrop rendering.
